seurat_ingestion.scope: Counts/metadata alignment and counts preservation only

scrna_qc.dataset: pbmc_small plus explicit three-gene arithmetic fixture
scrna_qc.scope: pbmc_small lacks mitochondrial/ribosomal genes; audit/filter and exact arithmetic guards only
scrna_qc.warnings: Data is of class matrix. Coercing to dgCMatrix.

lognormalize.scope: LogNormalize branch; preserves counts and creates finite RNA data layer

seurat_clustering.scope: PCA/neighbors/clustering/UMAP on all 80 cells; not full-atlas robustness
seurat_clustering.warnings:
The default method for RunUMAP has changed from calling Python UMAP via reticulate to the R-native UWOT using the cosine metric
To use Python UMAP via reticulate, set umap.method to 'umap-learn' and metric to 'correlation'
This message will be shown once per session

hierarchical_annotation.scope: Label writeback and Unknown fallback; biological annotations are not validated

cell_markers.scope: Exploratory cluster-marker table; no sample-level treatment inference
cell_markers.warnings: cannot compute exact p-value with ties

pseudobulk.scope: Raw-count summation/count conservation only; replicated condition testing is unvalidated

registry_unicode.scope: Registry Unicode preserved under Windows C locale

correlation.scope: Pearson/Spearman tests, BH adjustment and missing/constant-input regression cases; pooled species are confounded

survival_km.scope: Right-censored KM curve/CI table with explicit 0/1 event mapping; no new clinical interpretation

cox.scope: Cox HR/CI and proportional-hazards diagnostic output only; no predictive or causal certification
